people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: “It shall be eighteen thousand reeds around: and the name of the city from that day shall be, ‘Yahweh is there.’
translations.bsb: The perimeter of the city will be 18,000 cubits, and from that day on the name of the city will be: THE LORD IS THERE.”
translations.kjv: It was round about eighteen thousand measures: and the name of the city from that day shall be, The LORD is there.
translations.asv: It shall be eighteen thousand reeds round about: and the name of the city from that day shall be, Jehovah is there.
